Rule 6 of the prompt template does not apply to this patent: it was written for the reference patent's single eight-step Example 1, whereas this document prints three separately headed examples, which are kept as three sections. Procedure: 2 g tembotrione dissolved completely in acetone at the boil (56 degrees C), cooled to room temperature at less than 20 degrees C/h, crystals filtered off and dried below 60 degrees C. One step, a recrystallisation. No bond is formed or broken anywhere in this patent: input and output are the same molecule and only the crystal form changes.
